title: Not All the Outward Forms on Earth
description: Not All the Outward Forms on Earth in Tonic Solfa to ST. FLAVIAN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 95, headed “Regeneration, John 1. 13. and 3. 3 &c”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. FLAVIAN; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Not all the out-ward forms on earth, Nor rites that God has given, Nor will of man, nor blood, nor birth, Can raise a soul to heaven.

lines: Not all the outward forms on earth,
Nor rites that God has given,
Nor will of man, nor blood, nor birth,
Can raise a soul to heaven.
The sovereign will of God alone
Born in the image of his Son,
The Spirit like some heavenly wind
Blows on the sons of flesh,
New models all the carnal mind,
Our quicken'd souls awake, and rise
From the long sleep of death;
On heavenly things we fix our eyes,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. FLAVIAN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
